name: Daisy
source: Daisy is a special forces captain who spent years on missions around the world before finally being granted extended leave. She used it to call her friends together for a reunion party: she paid for the flights, coordinated everything and offered her place to sleep to anyone who stayed too late. She is the reason this group of women is together at all — a natural leader, warm and direct, who makes friends effortlessly and has heavy hands for when talking stops working.
